easy.q: How many stars is the top rating you can give a driver in the Uber app?
easy.fact: Riders and drivers rate each other on the same 1-to-5 scale.

easy.q: How many seconds must a pro bull rider stay on to get a score?
easy.fact: Touching the bull with the free hand during the ride means no score.

easy.q: How many U.S. presidents have had the last name Bush?
easy.fact: George H.W. Bush was the 41st president and his son George W. Bush the 43rd.

easy.q: Scandinavia is traditionally made up of how many countries?
easy.fact: They are Denmark, Norway and Sweden.

easy.q: How many days of Christmas are in the famous carol?
easy.fact: The gifts run from a partridge in a pear tree to twelve drummers drumming.

medium.q: In what year did PSY's "Gangnam Style" come out?
medium.fact: In 2012 it became the first YouTube video to pass 1 billion views.

medium.q: How many pounds does the Vince Lombardi Trophy weigh?
medium.fact: Tiffany & Co. makes the sterling silver trophy, which stands 22 inches tall.

medium.q: How many U.S. state capitals are named after a president?
medium.fact: They are Jackson, Jefferson City, Lincoln and Madison.

medium.q: The first U.S. census, in 1790, counted how many million people, to the nearest million?
medium.fact: The exact count was 3,929,214, gathered by U.S. marshals on horseback.

medium.q: Through 2025's The Final Reckoning, how many Mission: Impossible movies has Tom Cruise made?
medium.fact: The series began in 1996, based on the 1960s TV show.

hard.q: How tall is New York's One World Trade Center to the tip of its spire, in feet?
hard.fact: The height nods to 1776, the year of the Declaration of Independence.

hard.q: How many career hits did Pete Rose collect, the MLB record?
How many U.S. presidents were born in Virginia, more than any other state?
hard.fact: That's why Virginia is called the Mother of Presidents.

hard.q: The Phantom of the Opera ran on Broadway from 1988 to 2023. To the nearest year, how many years was that?
hard.fact: It is the longest-running show in Broadway history.
